limitations: Connected finite undirected symmetric positive-weight graphs; binary opinions and uniform-agent updates; \(|b_u|<1\); exact first-change bound only, not a full consensus-time formula; no independent audit.

title: Exact edgewise bias cancellation and fixation neutrality in partisan voter networks
